Bus.description: Runtime dispatcher: holds port, egress set, scheduler, observers, and the dispatch loop

BusHandle.description: Control handle returned by Bus::spawn; exposes shutdown and snapshot without access to the full runtime

BusPort.description: Ingress-side submission handle; creates sessions and submits frames

BusBuilder.description: Builder for Bus: accumulates egresses, scheduler, observers, and health policy before building

Registry.description: Plugin registry: holds egress plugins, observer plugins, scheduler, and health policy before runtime start

BusEvent.description: Observable bus lifecycle events plus routed core observation envelopes emitted to ObserverPlugin

payload.description: EventPayloadInner shape: flow/session/path metadata, byte counters, close reason, and success flag

BusError.description: Errors returned by Bus construction or operation

SessionHandle.description: Crate-internal L4 session bridge: frame submit sender + return event receiver, held by BusPort

RuntimeSnapshot.description: Point-in-time snapshot of runtime counters per exit, returned by BusHandle::snapshot

DataplaneShape.description: Per-flow forwarding shape derived at first Open from flow semantics, realized path count, egress capabilities, and transform requirements

FlowCounters.description: Per-flow byte counters shared between dispatch and the forwarder; updated atomically on every data transfer
